_ack_id.description: Acknowledgement ID for tracking event delivery (UUID)

_trigger_source_type.description: The type of system that triggered the event. Examples: api, automation, operation, portal_user

_trigger_source.description: Identifier of the specific trigger source. Examples: user ID, automation execution ID, activity ID, portal user email

_automation_chain.description: Ordered automation flow ids that caused this event; propagated verbatim for automation loop prevention

_has_pending_changesets.description: True when the triggering entity (or meter counter) has at least one pending changeset

_changeset_edit_modes.description: Distinct edit modes across the PENDING changesets — only "external" (synced from an external system) or "approval" (awaiting approval). A "direct" write is applied immediately, is not a pending changeset, and so never appears here.

_changeset_attributes.description: Keys identifying pending changesets. For attribute changesets these are attribute names (e.g. `billing_cycle`); for meter-reading changesets these are the changeset IDs from `meter._meter_readings_changeset`

_changeset_edit_modes_by_attribute.description: Per-key edit mode map; keys are a subset of _changeset_attributes (attribute names for entity changesets, changeset IDs for meter-reading changesets) — only those whose pending changeset has an "external" or "approval" mode. A "direct"/unrecognised mode is omitted here, though the key still appears in _changeset_attributes. Enables fine-grained webhook conditions such as `_changeset_edit_modes_by_attribute.billing_cycle equals approval`

workflow_definition_id.description: ID of the primary workflow's definition — the most recently updated running workflow on the opportunity, which need not be the grid process. Use `workflows` to find a specific process

workflow_status.description: Status of the primary workflow. A finished or cancelled workflow only shows here while no other workflow runs on the opportunity — read completion and cancellation from `workflows`

phase_id.description: ID of the current workflow phase. Stable per workflow definition — match on this rather than the name

phase_name.description: Name of the current workflow phase as configured by the organization

task_id.description: ID of the current workflow task

task_name.description: Name of the current workflow task

opportunity_status.description: Status of the opportunity: `open`, `in_progress`, `closed`, `cancelled`, or an organization-specific value its workflow writes (e.g. the current phase name)

definition_id.description: ID of the workflow definition. Stable per blueprint and organization — identify the grid process by this

status.description: Status of the workflow, e.g. `STARTED` while running, `DONE` once completed, `CLOSED` once cancelled

phase_id.description: ID of the current workflow phase. Stable per workflow definition — match on this rather than the name

phase_name.description: Name of the current workflow phase as configured by the organization

task_id.description: ID of the current workflow task

task_name.description: Name of the current workflow task

workflows.description: Every workflow on the opportunity, running or finished, in no particular order. Identify the grid process by `definition_id`; its `status` turns `DONE` on completion and `CLOSED` on cancellation. Empty when the opportunity has no workflow

stage.description: Where the process stands when the event fires: every workflow on the opportunity (`workflows`, with status, current phase and task), the primary workflow mirrored at the top level, and the opportunity status. Read completion and cancellation of a specific process from its entry in `workflows`.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf)

s3ref.description: S3 reference for the file content

version_index.description: Latest version index of the file (versions[].length - 1, or 0 if no versions array)

_tags.description: Tags on the file entity (semantic labels set by uploader/automation)

relation_tags.description: Tags on the relation pointing at the file (journey upload block tags such as "Lageplan", plus a hidden journey step marker)

_created_at.description: When the file entity was created — useful for time-window filtering

event_attachments.description: Every file related to the opportunity — the documents uploaded by the start journey and every follow-up journey. Empty when the process carries none. Consumers identify a given upload via `relation_tags` (the journey upload block tags) / `_tags`.
